items.claim: For thirty years Göbekli Tepe was called a temple nobody lived at. In September 2026 the first intact burials from the site were published: graves under the floors.

sources.title: First burials give insights into mortuary rites at Göbeklitepe (22 Sept 2026)
sources.publisher: Gresky J, Clare L, PLOS ONE 21(9): e0358979
sources.note: The two burials: a woman 35+, a man 20–30 and a girl 11–14 in one pit; a woman 20–30 in the second; 8,700–8,000 BCE; the 928 fragments; slope slides; 'does not rule out' other rites.
